news.headline:
Refex Renewables & Infrastructure's step-down subsidiary, Refex CBG Kolhapur, faces an operational dispute with Warana Sugar. Warana Sugar restricted plant access and disrupted utility supplies over alleged dues of ₹18.5 crore, severely impacting operations at the Kolhapur CBG plant.

Both companies have initiated legal proceedings in the District Civil Court, Kolhapur. Refex CBG Kolhapur disputes the claims, asserting the dues were fully settled during its August 2025 acquisition, and is pursuing interim relief to resume operations.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
In Q2 FY 2026-27, Titan Company's consumer businesses grew approximately 25% YoY, adding 78 net stores to reach 3,758 stores. Segment YoY growth saw Jewellery rise 21%, Watches 30%, EyeCare 28%, CaratLane 32%, and International surge 97%.

Jewellery saw strong studded performance and plain gold up around 20% YoY, while coin sales declined high single-digits. Demand softened towards the quarter's close due to the festive calendar shifting to Q3FY27. Numbers remain provisional.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
S&P Global Ratings has reaffirmed Union Bank of India's Issuer Credit Ratings at 'BBB/Stable/A-2' with a Stable outlook, while maintaining its stand-alone credit profile at 'bbb-'.

The stable outlook reflects expectations that the bank will maintain a steady capital cushion with risk-adjusted capital above 7% over 12-24 months, supported by stable earnings and very high likelihood of government support.

Source: BSE
